stock_segments.discussion_summary: Joel Eklund explains his mandatory bid on Hövding, increasing ownership to 65%. He sees Hövding as a fantastic product and innovation with a unique concept lacking close competition. The company makes airbag cycle helmets worn as a collar that deploy in accidents, protecting more of the head than traditional helmets. He believes in the urban micromobility theme. He acknowledges challenges including margin improvements and rollout costs. The product has strong penetration in Sweden and Denmark, and he believes in the Finnish market long-term.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Joel has been following Kjell & Company for over 10 years since first visiting for an education. He was captivated by their customer-centric culture where all employees were driven by helping customers with technology and electronics. When the company was preparing for IPO, he contacted them, met the management, and invested. Ten years later, the culture remained exactly the same. He sits on the board and believes hugely in the company's future. They are advanced with omni-channel, combining retail and e-commerce, using small stores as delivery hubs with click-and-collect. He believes this gives them a good positioning in the current retail landscape with a moderate valuation.

summary: Affärsvärlden Magasin besöker Joel Eklund, styrelseordförande för TP och ansvarig för investmentbolaget Fosilund med 2 miljarder i noterade innehav. Diskussionen kretsar kring hans investeringsfilosofi där han söker tillväxtbolag med internationell potential, helst med närhet till Malmö. Han har lagt bud på Hövding som han ser som en av de mest lovande bolagen i södra Sverige med sitt unika koncept för airbag-cykelhjälmar inom mikromobilitet. Han säljer hela sitt innehav i Lexington då grundarna ville sälja, trots att han gillade bolaget. Hans största innehav är Cellavision via Grenlunden, ett bolag med lång tillväxthistorik och lönsamhet. Han är även på styrelsen för Kjell & Company och investerat innan IPO i Youso. Joel delar även sin syn på Malmös näringsliv och behovet av mer industrimark.
